speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Could you please describe the breast mass you are concerned about, specifically regarding its size, texture, and whether it is painful?

speaker: Patient
text: 48-year-old woman. The patient noticed a mass in her left breast 4 weeks ago, which has rapidly increased in size. She denies any recent trauma or infections. No history of similar complaints in the past.

speaker: Doctor
text: Does the mass feel hard and irregular, or is it soft and rubbery, and have you noticed any skin changes like dimpling or redness? Also, is there any nipple discharge or family history of breast cancer?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Presence of a left breast mass. I also have Rapid increase in size of the mass, No skin or nipple changes, No pain associated with the mass.

speaker: Doctor
text: The mammogram shows a smooth polylobulated mass, which is reassuring, but the rapid growth is concerning. Can you tell me if you are currently pregnant or breastfeeding, and have you noticed any changes in the size of the mass throughout your menstrual cycle?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant past medical or surgical history. No family history of breast cancer. Social history: Non-smoker, moderate alcohol use. Elementary school teacher.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for providing those details. Given the rapid growth and the mammographic findings, I need to characterize the mass further to distinguish between benign and malignant causes. REQUEST TEST: Breast_Ultrasound

speaker: Doctor
text: The rapid growth of the mass is highly concerning despite the benign-appearing mammogram and normal ultrasound. I will request a biopsy to definitively rule out malignancy or a high-grade lesion like a phyllodes tumor. REQUEST TEST: Core_Needle_Biopsy

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Biopsy Microscopic Description: Image shows leaf-like structures with stromal cellular overgrowth.

speaker: Doctor
text: The biopsy findings of leaf-like structures with stromal cellular overgrowth are characteristic of a phyllodes tumor. Given the rapid growth and histological features, I am confirming the diagnosis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Phyllodes tumor
